title: New Tractors at J. Clark & Son, Main Street
description: Once the horse disappeared, farming tractors needed to be accessible, and J. Clark & Son on Main Street in Hartland answered the call by receiving a new shipment of up-to-date tractors. In the photo, from left to right: George Stanley, Perley Orser, James MacLeod, Arnold Seeley, Wilmot Dickinson, and unknown. Over time, combines replaced hand harvesting, while hay balers and potato diggers allowed farmers to work more land.
